title: Lab - Ingress networking 2
description: Deploy an Ingress controller from scratch.
scenario: Deploy an Ingress controller from scratch. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Namespace and ConfigMap
tasks.instructions: Create namespace ingress-nginx and an empty ConfigMap ingress-nginx-controller in it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create ns ingress-nginx
kubectl create cm ingress-nginx-controller -n ingress-nginx

tasks.title: Task 2 - RBAC and Deployment
tasks.instructions: Create the service account, roles and the controller Deployment.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Expose and route
tasks.instructions: Expose the controller as NodePort 30080 and create an Ingress for /wear and /watch.
tasks.solution:
kubectl expose deploy ingress-nginx-controller -n ingress-nginx --type=NodePort --port=80 --dry-run=client -o yaml > svc.yaml  # nodePort 30080
kubectl create ingress ingress-wear-watch -n app-space --rule="/wear=wear-service:8080" --rule="/watch=video-service:8080"
